notes.title: Hotfix Patch 0.1.4.33
notes.content:
[h1]A Flawless start[/h1]

[list]
[*] Tutorial Access Fix: Some content creators didn’t access the tutorial due to a save file issue where the game didn’t transition correctly after the cutscene. This has now been fixed, ensuring that everyone plays the tutorial smoothly and only once.  

[*] Generator Interaction Feedback: A gameplay notification has been added when attempting to interact with the generator if no blackout has occurred.  
[/list]

I'm actively refining the game's rough edges to make it shine, so stay tuned: exciting updates are coming!  

For now, enjoy leveling up in the facility! 🚀

notes.title: Mutation Giveaway and the start of a journey
notes.content:
[h1]The Beginning of a Journey[/h1]  

Mutation was released yesterday, marking both the end and the beginning of new chapters for my career as a developer, for the game itself, and for the community that I hope to grow together with!  

I’d like to inform you that if you don’t want to pay for the game and want to try your luck, there is an ongoing [b]giveaway with 80 game keys[/b] [url=https://www.indiedb.com/giveaways/mutation][b]on IndieDB![/b][/url]  

Additionally, if you want to watch a gameplay session [b][u]by a professional streamer with 15 million subscribers[/u][/b], here’s the gameplay by [b]iTownGamePlay *Terror&Diversión*:[/b]  

[h3]Gameplay Video:[/h3]  
[previewyoutube=hWI8iJ9mkDY;full][/previewyoutube]  
[i]I have to admit, I really enjoyed watching it (especially when the Abyssal Carcass gave him his first jumpscare! )[/i]

notes.title: Altars and Detectors
notes.content:
[h1]An increasingly heated fight against time[/h1]

Tired of not having enough tools at your disposal to survive? Introducing The Altar Replica, an object that channels resonance for the abomination and that you can disrupt with your Chronus Abyssus to delay the next mutation of the unclean being.

[u][h2]Replica of the Altar[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128065/3fdd93a93eefb509107f6663b1474744315eb145.gif[/img]

Just as mutative bags speed up the Mutation of Abomination by two minutes, altars slow it down by two. Now we're playing ( almost ) on a level playing field!

Speaking of mutative pouches, here's a new gadget for you:

[u][h2]M particle detector![/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128065/345df5d2f8c9f313b33146ba99f6a34c78f8b119.jpg[/img]

This gadget detects M particles inside the mutative pouches, indicating where they are so you can destroy them, search every tiny room to unearth this valuable aid!

Also added special effects to the skill point allocation in the Heart of Dagon and game credits in the archive section.

I have also fixed some minor bugs and glitches that were left over from the last update:

[u][h3]Fix List[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*]Fix waypoint bug where it would remain visible if you got too far away from the puzzle door once it was already created.
[*]Fix camera glitch when head rocking was off and the monster hit the player.
[*]Fix language text that appeared “ Italian ‘ instead of ’ English ” if the game was started in English.
[/list]

That's all for this update! This is probably the last update before the early access release, so see you there directly!

I would like to take this opportunity to thank all the friends and contributors who helped me get this far, you guys are awesome!

notes.title: Motion sickness and Mutative Blobs
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 0.1.4.2: A Comfortable Horror[/h1]

Some content creators have rightly pointed out that Mutation's immersive first-person perspective caused nausea for some players. 

To address this and improve accessibility, I’ve introduced the option to enable or disable head bobbing and motion blur. Along with the ability to adjust controller sensitivity, this should make the game more comfortable to play; hopefully reducing the need for ginger candies!

Additionally, the game language can now be changed at any time without additional loading screens, directly from the options menu.

[h2]Screenshot of the New Options[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128065/97fe4d743067b67384980fbd1221f1748b24b52d.png[/img]

[h2]New Content: Mutative Blob[/h2]

This small, revolting creature will desperately seek the abomination to be consumed by it. In exchange, the abomination will accelerate the development of its current mutation. I advise killing the thing before it fulfills its purpose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128065/276182555dc9921f58e252566b3600e5135fd490.gif[/img]

These were the highlights! Below is the full list of fixes and additions in this patch:

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] New creature: Mutative Sac.
[*] [b]Options:[/b] Head bobbing, motion blur, and language selection options added. A link to the Discord channel has also been included in the options menu.
[*] [b]Audio:[/b] New ambient music for the Sewers and Laboratory levels. Music now stops during blackouts, increasing tension.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] It’s no longer possible to kick while crouched. Options now save and load correctly. Camera issues when reaching the end-run portal have been resolved.
[*] [b]Options:[/b] Head bobbing, motion blur, and language selection options added.
[*] [b]Audio:[/b] New ambient music for the Sewers and Laboratory levels.
[/list]

notes.title: New tutorial and better options
notes.content:
[h3][b]A New Tutorial and Improved Options[/b][/h3]

Hi everyone, Manuel here, the developer of Mutation.

I’ve noticed that many content creators and players weren’t satisfied with the tutorial, and to be honest, I wasn’t either. I apologize for that! At the time, I didn’t have enough resources or time to create a better experience.

Today, I’m excited to announce that [b][u]a brand-new tutorial level is now available[/u][/b] with the latest update! This updated tutorial covers the game’s core mechanics, providing a much smoother introduction to Mutation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128065/384d22b2976491ddced5faf7bc3526677ba450d9.png[/img]

I’ve also noticed that some players weren’t seeing any changes in the options menu when tweaking settings. This was because many didn’t press the “Apply Changes” button. After watching several streams and receiving feedback, I decided to implement immediate application of settings. Now, any changes you make should take effect right away.

[b][u]Note:[/u][/b] The "Windowed Fullscreen Mode" currently doesn’t adjust resolution properly when changed. This bug will be addressed in the next hotfix, which will be released soon.

Thank you for your patience and support, keep the feedback coming!
